I have 7 photos and the society bylaws clearly state that common wall modifications require written approval from the maintenance committee. I have submitted a complaint to the secretary Rahul Bhat but no action has been taken for 5 weeks.
respondent_statement: The AC unit was installed by a licensed technician following all safety norms. Several other residents including Adonis Jeswin in E-353 have similar installations. The noise level is within acceptable limits as per municipal guidelines. The society rules the claimant refers to were last updated 6 years ago and many units have been installed since without objection.

claimant_statement: I attended Professor Yash Vijay Singh's Digital Logic Design class on January 14. I was present for the entire lecture and even participated in the discussion about chapter 7 concepts. My classmate Yash Vijay Singh can verify my attendance. However, the attendance register shows me as absent. I have a screenshot of the seating arrangement and my notes from that day's lecture on Digital Logic Design fundamentals.
respondent_statement: Attendance was taken using the biometric system at 10:05 AM as per department policy. The student's ID was not recorded on the biometric device until 9:46 AM, which is 30 minutes late. Our department policy allows a 20-minute grace period only. The attendance policy was clearly communicated in the course handout on Day 1.

claimant_statement: Arjun Verma promised to help me with completing a group assignment on June 6 and I made arrangements accordingly — I cancelled my other plans and prepared everything needed. On the day, Arjun Verma did not show up and did not inform me in advance. Because of this, I missed a doctor's appointment. I have our WhatsApp conversation confirming the commitment.
respondent_statement: I had an emergency on June 6 and could not fulfil the commitment. I informed Isha Aggarwal to pass the message. I apologized the next day and offered to help on an alternative date. The claimant's claim about a doctor's appointment is exaggerated — there were other options available that they chose not to pursue.

claimant_statement: I was terminated from my position as Data Analyst at BrightPath Innovations on December 15 without the 30-day notice period specified in my employment contract. My last 1 performance reviews were rated 'Outstanding'. I am owed Rs 219301 for the notice period and 24 days of unused leave. I have my offer letter, performance reviews, and the termination email.
respondent_statement: The employee's role was eliminated as part of a company-wide restructuring affecting 13 positions. A severance package of Rs 51012 (1 months' salary) was offered as per company policy. The restructuring was communicated to all department heads on December 1. The performance rating is not relevant to a restructuring-based separation.

claimant_statement: I ordered a wireless earbuds (model: v9.5) on November 3 but received a different, inferior model. The listing showed premium build material but the received product lacks it. I have screenshots of the original listing, the delivery package, and unboxing video. The seller is refusing a full refund of Rs 5086 and offering only an exchange with a 15-day wait time.
respondent_statement: Due to a temporary inventory issue, a comparable model was shipped as a substitute. The customer was notified via email on August 8 about the substitution with an option to cancel. The substitute model has equivalent specifications and is valued at Rs 16032 — actually higher than the original order. We are offering an immediate exchange or store credit.

claimant_statement: I purchased a digital subscription on an online marketplace for Rs 10410/year on December 17. The service was discontinued without notice on March 14 — 8 months before my subscription expires. I was not offered a refund or alternative. I have the payment receipt and the original service description which promises ad-free experience. 456 other users have reported the same issue.
respondent_statement: The service transition was announced via email on November 7, 25 days before the change. All active subscribers were offered migration to our new Premium Plus plan at no additional cost, which includes enhanced features. The original terms state that services may be modified with 15-day notice. A pro-rata refund option was available until October 7.

claimant_statement: I submitted my Operating Systems project on April 9 before the deadline of April 3. I have the submission confirmation email and the project was marked 70/100 by Professor Sneha Thakur. However, another student Rahul Bhat submitted a very similar project after the deadline and received 84/100. I believe the grading is unfair and inconsistent.
respondent_statement: The grading rubric was published and followed consistently. The student's project had 3 issues in the testing section which were clearly marked in the feedback. Rahul Bhat's project, while submitted 1 day(s) after with a 15% late penalty applied, demonstrated superior algorithmic efficiency which earned additional marks. Each project was evaluated independently on merit.

claimant_statement: My landlord Isha Aggarwal is demanding that I vacate the property at A-204, Green Valley Apartments within 6 days without proper notice. The lease agreement specifies a 90-day notice period. I have been a responsible tenant paying Rs 34711/month rent on time for 7 months. I have all payment receipts and the lease document. The landlord wants to sell the property and is pressuring me to leave early.
respondent_statement: The tenant was informed 23 days ago about the need to vacate. The property requires urgent structural repairs that cannot be done with occupants. I offered Rs 26255 as relocation assistance and an additional 15 days beyond the notice. The tenant has been causing noise complaints which was reported by neighbours on January 16.
